as_told.title: Sitchin's Anunnaki genetic experiments on primate ancestors

plain: In the myths of Sumer, the ancient civilization of Mesopotamia, the gods called the Anunnaki are said to have made humans as workers, and some modern writers read this as genetic engineering by visitors. The philosopher Jason Jorjani puts it this way: "the Sumerian myths tell us that when the Anunnaki engineered a slave race on Earth." He draws on the writer Zecharia Sitchin, who read these ancient texts this way. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of the mind with a doctorate, sums up Sitchin more softly. He says Sitchin "suggests that the ancient gods, the Anunnaki, performed genetic experiments on our primate ancestors," and does not mention slaves. If it were true, humans would have been designed by beings from somewhere else.
